name: Esportsarr
description: Consolidates per-league esports channels (LCS/LEC/LCK/LPL, VCT Americas/EMEA/Pacific) into a fixed number of generic channels per game, switching the active stream to whichever live match currently holds priority.
author: 4rn0d

fields.label: Schedule JSON URL
fields.help_text: Raw URL to schedule.json published by the scraper's GitHub Actions workflow, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<user>/esportsarr/main/scraper/output/schedule.json

fields.label: Poll interval (seconds)
fields.help_text: How often the background scheduler re-fetches schedule.json and re-evaluates stream priority.

fields.label: Channels per game
fields.help_text: How many generic channels (e.g. "LoL 1", "LoL 2", "LoL 3") to consolidate each game's leagues into. More slots means fewer matches get dropped/delayed when several leagues overlap. Must match what you ran 'Create Channels' with.

fields.label: Channel group name
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr channel group the generic channels are created under.

fields.label: LoL league priority (comma-separated, highest first, INTL will always come first)
fields.help_text: When more LoL matches are live than there are slots, leagues earlier in this list keep a slot; later ones wait for a slot to free up.

fields.label: Valorant league priority (comma-separated, highest first, INTL will always come first)
fields.default: Champions,VALORANT Masters,Game Changers Championship,VCT Americas,VCT EMEA,VCT Pacific,Last Chance Qualifier Americas,Last Chance Qualifier EMEA,Last Chance Qualifier Pacific,Game Changers NA,Game Changers EMEA,Game Changers Pacific
fields.help_text: Same as the LoL priority setting, for Valorant leagues. Must exactly match Riot's league name (run 'python -m esportsarr.list_leagues --game valorant' in the scraper repo), e.g. 'Game Changers NA', not 'Game Changers Americas'.

fields.label: Reservation lookahead (minutes)
fields.help_text: How far ahead a higher-priority match can preview/reserve a slot that's genuinely idle (nothing live wants it). Must be >= reservation_priority_minutes.

fields.label: Reservation priority window (minutes)
fields.help_text: How close to start a higher-priority match must be to actually compete for a slot that's about to free up. Wide enough to cover typical multi-hour gaps between back-to-back matches sharing a regional channel (e.g. VCT then Game Changers on the same Twitch channel). This never preempts a match already occupying a slot; a reserved/previewed slot keeps showing its last stream, it doesn't go blank.

fields.label: Guide lookahead (days)
fields.help_text: How many days ahead the guide shows real match data before falling back to "No Match Scheduled" filler. Overlapping matches across leagues are resolved the same way live sync is: the higher-priority one shows, the other is simply omitted for that window rather than queued.

fields.label: Twitch StreamProfile name
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr can't play a raw twitch.tv URL on its own. This must be the exact name of the streamlink-capable StreamProfile that makes it playable (Twitcharr installs one under this name; it only needs to have run once, it doesn't need to be tracking any specific league's channel). If Twitcharr renames its profile or you use a different one, update this to match.

fields.label: YouTube StreamProfile name
fields.help_text: For leagues that are YouTube-only (e.g. LPL). Dispatcharr can't play a raw youtube.com URL on its own either. The default here just tries the same profile as Twitch as an unverified guess, it has NOT been confirmed to actually work for YouTube. If it doesn't, set up a streamlink- or yt-dlp-capable StreamProfile yourself and point this at its exact name.

actions.label: Create Channels
actions.description: Idempotently creates the channel group, the generic per-game channels, and the dedicated EPG source this plugin manages. Run this once before enabling the scheduler.

actions.label: Sync Now
actions.description: Runs one allocation pass immediately (fetch schedule.json, reassign stream priority) without waiting for the next poll tick. Use this to verify behavior against a known live match before trusting the automatic scheduler.
